text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Chunichi Shimbun Hai is here. As Nice Nature patiently awaits the start of the race in her waiting room, she is visited by Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Concerned for Nice Nature after noticing her screaming into the tree stump at school, they've come to check on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature assures them that she is fully recovered and confidently makes her way to the race.
